'''2007 Dantooine Regionals Philip Reyna DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Philip Reyna]] at [[2007 Dantooine Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|SE-D-carbonchambertesting.gif}}
